scope: Existing ordinary finite-FOV real-keyboard frames reviewed directly; no browser, no diagnostic fullbright used. Named directions are requested capture inputs, visual review follows actual pixels.

groups.finding: Actual local views share blue laminated tall mass, pale cut edge, purple quiet floor and one L opening. Current proportion change is insufficient. Only sentinel is being reorganized as connected high/low shoulders with differently directed real mouths.

Pleated hide is a broad folded sheet route, felt has two actual concave cavities separated by a solid thick divider, pale sail has two facing sheets and a staggered through gap. Difference survives ignoring color. Eastern pleated frame mostly shows bare floor: not proof of all outside edges. Quilted-scars awaits its own batch and cannot be pre-approved.

Crystal has a multi-direction fork junction with fine linear fibres rather than a continuous rear spine enclosing slots. Rib-vault shows a separate shorter/lower rib group across a quiet connecting bed; amber shows one larger thick closed-head slot group and a low flow tail reached by an outside bypass. Visible fine layered ribs versus coarse thick resin cut faces offer a physical distinction, but rib-vault/amber share the comb grammar strongly. This is bounded local organization evidence, not whole-route fatigue approval.
nonColorDifferences: Two unequal separated rib groups with connecting quiet bed versus one thick comb with low flow tail.

rootIndependentReview.verdict: Bounded difference accepted: thick resin closed-head groove and low tail versus fine layered higher main rib group plus shorter group with open connection. Shared comb family remains a weak-neighbor risk, not alone a reason to rebuild. No whole-route fatigue approval.

groups.finding: Bleached is a high broad bank with a deep incomplete-side recess and a separate small fragment; chalk has two thick rough stepped banks with an offset walkable floor gap; satin is crossed low relief leaf surfaces with a localized raised fold; lacquer shows a low layered bank below a separate higher broken ridge. The low traversable relief versus blocking thick bank is the primary non-color difference; high/low distribution and passage orientation provide the second. The chalk gap was previously independently checked as real ground, not walking atop the projected bank.
nonColorDifferences: Crossable relief versus high blocking bank, with visibly different edge thickness.
Single broad-bank recess versus paired offset banks versus low open fan with a localized high fold; different approach and bypass paths.
